Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this low-scoring but entertaining game. The Trans-Tasman rivalry is up and running in style and the second ODI is on Thursday, 8th September at 9.50 am IST (4.20 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Cameron Green (89* off 92 balls) is the Player of the Match. The tall all-rounder says that he is feeling tired and sore as his groin, calf, hamstring and forearms are gone at the moment. Hopes that he has a couple of days off and he will be fine. He praises Zampa and calls him the finisher. Lauds the batting effort of Carey too and shares that the plan was to stick around till the end. Tells that it means a lot to score his first ODI fifty and get his side over the line.

Kane Williamson, the captain of New Zealand, says the game ebbed and flowed on a tricky surface. Adds they needed a few more runs on the board. Calls the stand of Alex Carey and Cameron Green outstanding. Mentions that they tried hard and had Australia five down but then failed to get that breakthrough. Feels that they adapted to the conditions really quickly as it was a difficult pitch to bat on.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they have made a habit of making these chases close. Praises Alex Carey and Cameron Green for soaking a lot of pressure and feels that it would have been better had they finished the job. Credits New Zealand for their fightback. Mentions that there is still a lot of work to be done. Tells that it's an extraordinary effort from Green who will be sore and tired after facing all the cramps.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

This defeat for New Zealand is only and only due to a flavourless batting show. To provide context, their last six wickets fell for just 53 runs and that meant New Zealand were left with a below-par total on the board. As mentioned earlier, Trent Boult and Matt Henry were brilliant up front but the same intensity was lacking in the middle overs. The Kiwis did manage to break the stand between Carey and Green and then removed Glenn Maxwell and Mitchell Starc quickly as well, but the presence of Cameron Green didn't allow them to go all the way. The little contribution from Adam Zampa cannot be ignored which helped Green in the end who was struggling with cramps.

The chase started in the worst possible way for the home team. Aaron Finch fell again to one of his nemeses Trent Boult who was in fiery form. He removed Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne in quick succession as well, and then Matt Henry hunted down David Warner and Marcus Stoinis to put Australia's chase in the doldrums. With their backs to the wall, the pair of Cameron Green and Alex Carey joined forces and led the rescue act. They survived a few edgy moments and then looked at ease as the pitch settled down and the softer balls stopped doing much. Their record century stand stole the momentum away from the Kiwis, and Australia eventually crossed the line, but not without a late scare.

An unconvincing win for Australia, to say the least! Not the way they would have liked to reach the target, but they have reached it nonetheless. To sum it up in one line - They flaunted their batting depth in a rather insipid show to take the lead in this 3-match series. Australia now have 100 points in the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Super League 2020-2022/23, and winning the next two games will take them to the top, above England.
Wide! What an anticlimax! Ferguson goes short but down the leg side. Zampa steps back and then leaves it alone. The umpire stretches his arms and Australia win by 2 wickets.
Full and on leg. Zampa drills it past the diving mid-wicket fielder and the ball rolls to long on. A single. Scores are level.

Tossed up, outside off. Zampa pushes it past point and collects a brace. Poor from the fielder, he throws it at the striker's end when everyone knows that Green is struggling with cramps. Anyway, excellent running particularly from Green who is struggling right now.
Common sense prevails. The covers are being taken off now. Both the batters are back in the middle. Mitchell Santner to continue...

Are they going off? Oh no, the umpires have called for covers. Australia are only 4 runs away from winning. They though are ahead on the DLS count. Both the batters are walking off the field. The New Zealand players have stayed out.

FOUR! Zampa showing his batting skills here! What a shot from Australia's number 10. Tossed up, around off. Zampa slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and the ball bounces right in front of the ropes. Four runs needed now.
Slower in the air, flatter and outside off, Green cuts it to deep cover-point for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, Zampa punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
Full and on off, Zampa defends it back.
Another halt! Cameron Green needs some more treatment. The physios are stretching his legs. He looks good to go now. It's drizzling a bit but the umpires are continuing...

A single and Zampa will keep the strike! Length and outside off. Zampa guides it to deep point for a single. Cameron Green is standing between New Zealand and the victory line. Australia need just 10 runs now.
That's an audacious attempt from Australia's number 10. An off-cutter, on a length and outside off, Zampa makes room and looks to slap it over the off side but misses.
On the pads, Green flicks it firmly down to fine leg. Green is limping as he runs across. There is a slight hesitation for the run but both cross in the end.
Pitches it up, outside off, it is driven to mid off. Green and Zampa are having a quick chat here.
FOUR! Green playing a gem of an innings here! A slower, short ball on middle and leg. Green heaves it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
This is very full, outside off. Green looks to drive but toe-ends his shot and the ball dies on its way to the keeper.
Fuller ball, angling on middle and leg. Zampa defends it from the back foot. Australia need 16 runs now.
Tossed up, outside off, it's pushed to point.
Full, floated and outside off, it is swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Green gets on his knee as he looks to sweep but misses.
Santner flights one now, full and outside off, it is driven to mid off.
Wide! Floated, full and way outside off. Green leaves it alone. A wide is given.
A single! Flatter and on middle. Zampa flicks it on the up and past square leg for a single. Zampa has done his job!
Mitchell Santner (8-0-35-0) replaces Trent Boult. This is a bold move by Kane Williamson to bring in a spinner at this stage of the game. He could have gone with James Neesham.
Fuller ball, outside off, nipping in. Green prods and defends it out. Zampa will be on strike for the next over, much to the liking of New Zealand. 19 needed more.
FOUR! What a shot! Cameron Green is all set to take his team over the line! This is short and on middle. Green pulls it hard through square leg for a boundary.

Slight halt in play! Looks like Cameron Green is cramping up. The physio is giving him some massage on the calf muscles. 23 runs needed off 50 balls and Australia need Green back on his feet. The big boy is up and ready to go now...
THREE RUNS! On a length and outside off. Zampa guides it through the point region for three runs. Zampa just needs to stick there along with Green!
Another yorker, wide of off. Zampa tries to play it away but misses.
Ferguson nails the yorker this time on middle. Zampa does well to get his bat down and block it.
Adam Zampa walks out to the middle now.

OUT! Australia are 8 down and this game is heading to a close finish now. 26 needed off 53 balls. Back of a length, around leg at 144.8 kph, Starc tries to fend it away but he does so uppishly towards square leg where Daryl Mitchell takes a simple catch. New Zealand have a sniff here!
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Who will walk out now?
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Starc sticks back and tries to flick but misses.
Short in length and around middle. Starc is hurried as he fends it on the leg side for a quick single.
On a length and on middle. Starc stays back to defend.
Mitchell Starc comes out to bat now. He just needs to stick around with Green and the game is theirs.

OUT! Maxwell holes out! It appeared to be a clean shot, would have been a biggie on any other ground but here, he's caught near the fence. On a length and around middle and leg. Maxwell whips it away and hits it high in the air towards deep square leg. James Neesham runs to his right near the fence and takes a sharp catch. This game is not over yet.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, pushed to covers.
On a length and going across, around off. Maxwell shuffles across and looks to defend but gets hit on the pads and the ball goes to the keeper.
Full and on off, Maxwell mistimes his drive to mid on.
Powerplay 3! Now, a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle till the end of this chase.

The plan almost worked for the Kiwis. The field is set for the short ball and Ferguson bowls this short, on off, Glenn Maxwell ramps it in the air towards third man. Luckily for him, it falls well short of the fielder and the batters get a run.
Fuller one and on off, Glenn Maxwell drills it towards mid off.
This is pitched up, on off, Glenn Maxwell looks to drive it but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length and on leg, Cameron Green pulls it from the toe end of his bat towards fine leg for one more.
Glenn Maxwell gets off the mark as he tucks this length ball towards fine leg for a run.
Glenn Maxwell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Against the run of play, New Zealand have a wicket. The 158-run stand has been broken but is it too late for the Kiwis? 31 needed more off 65 balls. Coming to the delivery, it's short and outside off, Alex Carey stays back and tries to pull it over the infield on the leg side but ends up hitting it straight into the hands of Matt Henry at wide mid on. Carey is clearly disappointed to not finish the chase. He departs to a standing ovation from the crowd.
Commentary.Howout: c Matt Henry b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Powered away! Boult steams in from 'round the wicket and slants in a length ball around off, Green camps back, uses the angle of the bowler and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 11 from the over, 31 needed more.
Full and on the leg stump line, Alex Carey pushes it a bit uppishly but down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Aerial but in the gap! The 150-run stand comes up as well. A length ball outside off, Carey reaches out and smacks it over extra cover for a boundary.
A slower one, full and on middle, Alex Carey chips it over the bowler for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, Alex Carey crunches it but straight to mid off.
This is on a good length and on off, Alex Carey blocks it to the off side.
Change. Trent Boult is back into the attack for his final two overs. New Zealand need a wicket badly now.

FOUR! Superbly played! Lockie Ferguson pitches it up and around off, and Cameron Green doesn't try to hit it too hard. He just shows the full face of his bat and times his lofted shot over the bowler's head for a glorious boundary. 42 needed more.
Full and on leg, Alex Carey eases it towards mid on for a quick single.

DROPPED! It's safe to say that's that for New Zealand. Lockie Ferguson digs it in short, around off, Cameron Green fails to control the extra bounce and pulls it off the top edge. It flies towards fine leg where Trent Boult comes ahead to take the catch but the ball drifts away at the last moment and he ends up dropping it. The batters cross.
Ferguson goes short again and on middle, Alex Carey pulls it on the bounce to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker now, on middle, Alex Carey digs it out to the off side.
Starts off on the shorter side, on off, Alex Carey pushes it towards mid off.
Change. Lockie Ferguson (5-0-35-0) is back on.
Fires one down the leg side, Alex Carey works it through mid-wicket for a run. These two batters are making it look easy now.
Looped up, on off, turning in, Alex Carey makes room and punches it towards covers.
Darted full, on middle, Alex Carey drives it back to Santner.
Tossed up, full and on off, Cameron Green drags it through square leg for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Alex Carey reverse-sweeps it past covers for a single.
Flatter and quicker, on middle, Alex Carey knocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Thumped! Back of a length, around off, Cameron Green rocks back and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. This is now the best sixth-wicket partnership in ODIs for Australia against New Zealand, overtaking the record set by Michael Clarke and Michael Hussey (136).
Goes fuller and on middle and leg, Alex Carey flicks it uppishly, but it falls well short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. A run is taken.
Shorter one, on middle, Cameron Green pulls it on the bounce towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length and on off, Alex Carey pushes it towards covers for a single.

Mix-up but no harm is done. Full and on middle, Cameron Green helps it towards wide mid on and steps out. Carey also responds but then turns to see the fielder and stops. Seeing that Carey also stops but as soon as the fielder makes a slight fumble, he sets off again. Carey though takes a moment to look back and then scoots to the other end. Plenty of drama for a single.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Cameron Green pulls it wide of the deep backward square leg fielder for a brace.
FOUR! Wow, what a fluent shot! Floated and full, around off, Alex Carey shows the long extension of his arms and lofts it cleanly over mid off for a boundary. Classy.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Kane Williamson has no option but to take his chance by reviewing the decision. It's a loopy delivery, landing full outside off and turning in, Alex Carey sits down on one knee to sweep but misses and is rapped on the front leg. The appeal is made but nothing from the umpire. Is the impact outside off? Yup, very much. The Ball Tracking has confirmed it. Carey can carry on. 66 needed off 91 balls.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Cameron Green sweeps it hard but straight to the deep square leg fielder for just a run.
Flatter one, on middle, Cameron Green works it to the left of mid-wicket where the fielder dives and stops it. Three dots in a row now!
Shorter again, on off, Green punches it towards covers.
Shortish and on middle, Cameron Green goes back and knocks it towards mid-wicket.

Drinks! Since the last Drinks break, things have completely changed as New Zealand have failed to break the stand and the game is tilting towards the hosts. The stand now moves to 122 and just 67 runs are needed now. Australia still have Glenn Maxwell to come but will hope the job is done without him. Mitchell Santner is back on.
Back of a length and on middle, Cameron Green goes on his back foot and tucks it towards deep square leg for another run.
WIDE! Fuller but down the leg side, Cameron Green misses his flick. Wided.
Short and on the leg stump line, Alex Carey pulls it through square leg for a single.
Another dot! Alex Carey is feeling the pressure of the dots and tries to use his feet, Henry pulls his length back a bit, on off, Carey pushes it towards covers.
Three dots in a row! This is short and on off, Alex Carey mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! This is a slower one, on a length and on off, Alex Carey looks for the drive on the up but cannot connect.
On a length and around off, Alex Carey knocks it to the off side.
A dot to end the over! This is full again and on middle, angling in, Cameron Green blocks it out.
Full and on middle, Cameron Green pushes it towards covers.
Another short delivery, on middle, Alex Carey pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Goes fuller and on middle, Alex Carey stays there and smashes it over the bowler's head and wide of long on for a brace.
Shorter in length and on middle, Cameron Green slaps it towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Put away! Good signs if you are supporting Australia. Short in length and outside off, angling away, Green rocks back to cut and it flies off the outer half and scoots past backward point for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Cameron Green lofts it with the bottom of his bat towards long on for another run.
Henry lands this short and on middle, Alex Carey pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one and around off, Alex Carey drives it firmly but straight to mid off.
FOUR! Crunching shot! This pitch has eased out now and the soft balls are not doing much. Fuller in length, around leg, Carey whips it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Short of a length and on off, Alex Carey cuts it onto the ground towards covers.
This is on a good length and on off, keeps low, Cameron Green swings at it but misses and Latham lets it through him too. A bye is taken.
A slower length ball now, on off, Alex Carey mistimes his punch towards cover.
On a length and around off, Alex Carey pushes it towards point.
Lands this short and on off, Cameron Green stays there and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on middle, Alex Carey drives it towards long on for one.
FIFTY up for Cameron Green! This is full and down the leg side, Cameron Green flicks it towards fine leg for a single. This has been a great knock under pressure from the big boy.
Short and on middle, Alex Carey pulls it through square leg for a single.

Angling on the pads, Carey flicks it behind square leg for a single. The 100-run stand is now up between these two. Probably turning into a match-winning one. What a knock so far from both of them! Australia need 89 runs in 120 balls.
Trent Boult to continue as the desperation is creeping in for New Zealand for a breakthrough.
Wide! Shorter but down the leg side. Carey misses his pull.
Brilliant stop from Guptill! Length ball, outside off. Green punches it to the left of point. Guptill dives and makes a one-handed stop. Cannot prevent the single though.
On a length and around off. Green defends right under his eyes.
Outside off, guided through point for one more.
Fuller ball, outside off. Green pushes it wide of mid off where Matt Henry makes a tumbling stop. A single.
Length and on the pads, it is flicked in the gap to deep square leg for a couple.
Two more! Full and straight from Boult. Carey nudges it to square leg for a brace. Australia need 96 more runs to win.
On middle. Green flicks off the inner portion of the bat to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Green chops it to backward point.
Very full, wide of off. Green pushes it to the right of mid off.
Length ball, around off. Blocked to covers.

Boult creates a chance straightaway! A cross-seam delivery, full and on middle. Carey closes the face of the bat too early and gets a top edge. The ball lobs over Boult and drops behind him safely. The batters cross. Under 100 needed now.
Finally, Kane Williamson brings back Trent Boult (5-2-12-3) into the attack. New Zealand need a wicket here and Boult is their best option.

FOUR! Second of the over! Green is nearing his fifty as well! Seems like the game is running away from the tourists! Too straight on middle, Green whacks it in front of square leg for a boundary. 12 from the over!
On a length and on off. Defended out.
Another quick single! This is good running! Length and on middle. Carey tucks it to mid on and gets to the other end quickly.
Wide! Drops a short ball, around leg. Carey misses his pull. A wide is given for height.
Risky single! Short in length and on middle. Green bunts it to mid-wicket and hurries to the other end.
On middle, flicked through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Alex Carey! This is full and on middle. Carey drives it past mid on for four. Boundaries are coming easily now. This is Carey's 7th ODI fifty. He came at a very difficult time but has done the repair work brilliantly.
FOUR! Freebie! A gentle full toss on middle. Green puts it away as he sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, stays a bit low. Green plays it very late to short third man.
Tossed up, outside off, it is swept behind square leg for a run.
Slower in the air, full and outside off. Carey keeps it out.
Full and on off. Green uses his feet and drives it to long off for one more.
Tossed up on off. Green defends off the back foot.
On a length and outside off, nips a bit away. Carey looks to defend but misses.
Leg bye! A yorker but angling down. Green fails to jam it out. A leg bye as it rolls to square leg.
Another quick single! Fuller ball, outside off. Carey drives it to mid off and calls for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end this time.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.

Tap and run! Full and outside off. Carey pushes it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder throws it to the keeper who removes the bails off and appeals. The square leg umpire refers the decision upstairs and the replay shows that Green has his bat dragged inside the crease. A direct hit was the need of the hour.
FOUR! Helped away! Short and on the hips. Carey tickles it to fine leg for four.

Outside off, swept to deep square leg for one more to end the over. New Zealand need a wicket now as they don't have many runs to play with. Perhaps, Kane Williamson needs to bring Trent Boult back on for a couple of overs.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
On middle. Defended out.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Tossed up, angling in on leg. Green gets on his knee and sweeps it hard through square leg for four.
Tossed up on middle, it's flicked to square leg.
Slides one full, outside off. Green chops it to backward point.
Short in length, on middle, it's pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Green chips it to mid off.
Length ball, outside off. Carey works it through covers for a single. 100 up for Australia. They need another 133 runs to win.
Outside off, it's punched to covers.
A bit of width, outside off. Alex mistimes his drive to extra cover.
Short in length and outside off. Carey dabs it to backward point.
Green pushes it to mid-wicket for another dot ball. The required rate is only 5, so that's not a concern for Australia, they can afford to play out a few dots.
Touch quicker, full and on the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
A flighted and full ball on middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up, around off. Carey forces it to long on for one.
Around off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Flatter, slower and on middle, eased down to long on for one.
Length and slanting on the pads. Green whips it behind square on the leg side and Boult makes a good stop in the deep. A single is taken.
On middle, kept out.
Through the gap for three runs! Pitched up, outside off. Carey drives it firmly past the cover fielder for three runs. The stand between these two is worth more than 50 now!
Touch short, on middle. Green pulls it behind square leg for a run.
On a length, outside off. Green guides it to point.
Length and on middle. Blocked to mid-wicket.
James Neesham has been introduced into the attack.
Full, outside off, turning in. Carey drives it to mid off.
Around off, blocked out.
SIX! These two are finding their form now. Tossed up, around off and spinning in. Carey steps across and slogs it high over wide long on for a biggie.
Quicker ball, shorter and on middle, Carey works it to mid on.
Flatter and on leg, it is flicked past mid-wicket for a single.

In the air but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Carey has to reach for it as he comes out with a reverse-batted shot. He gets a top edge and it flies over backward point and away from the fielder in the deep. A single.
Full and on middle, angling in, Cameron Green knocks it back towards the bowler. 149 needed off 180 balls.
Sharp pacy bouncer! This is banged in short and on off, skids through, Cameron Green does not pick it but does well avoid it.

On a length and on off, Alex Carey takes a couple of steps forward and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end and the fielder backing up fails to stop the ball with a dive. There is a chance for an overthrow but both the batters have run in a bit too deep.
Fuller one, on leg, Alex Carey flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

EDGY FOUR! Another streaky boundary for Australia and they have the luck on their side at the moment. Lockie Ferguson serves it full and fast, outside off at 148.5 kph, Alex Carey leans forward to drive but gets a big inside edge. It misses the stumps by a whisker and hurries past the right side of the keeper for a boundary.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Alex Carey gets cramped but does well to negotiate it.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Alex Carey reverse sweeps it uppishly through cover-point for a single.
Sensible batting! Green rotates the strike as he comes down the track to drive this full ball towards long off for one.

SIX! Smacked! The big man flexes his muscles. Michael Bracewell serves it short and around off, Cameron Green uses the depth of the crease, drops his weight on the back leg and pulls it thunderously in front of square on the leg side for a maximum.
Floated and around off, Cameron Green uses his feet to get to the pitch of it and pushes it towards covers.
On off, kept out.
Nicely tossed up, on off, grips and turns in sharply, Cameron Green look to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short of a length and outside off, Cameron Green guides it with an open face through point for a run.
On a length and on off, Cameron Green moves across and blocks it towards covers.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Australia need that luck at this moment. Lockie Ferguson bends his back and digs it in short around off at 147.9 clicks, Cameron Green goes on his toes and tries to push it through the line but it takes a thick inside edge, beats the stumps and races away to the fence at fine leg.
Full and on off, angling away at 149.8 kph, Alex Carey knocks it towards covers for a single.
BEAUTY! This is a pacy delivery, on a length and on off, nips in a bit, Alex Carey goes for the drive but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Full and on middle, Cameron Green flicks it through square leg for one.
Looped up on middle, Cameron Green comes down the track and pushes it towards covers for one.
Flighted, full and on middle, Alex Carey reverse-sweeps it through cover-point for one.
Tossed up, on middle, Alex Carey uses his feet and tries to block it but misses and gets hit on the pads again.
Angles in a full delivery, on leg, Alex Carey misses his flick and gets hit on his back pad.
On middle, blocked out.
Floated, short and on off, turning in sharply, Cameron Green goes back and forces it towards long on for a single.

DRINKS! Australia needed this break! They need a few seconds to think of this chase as New Zealand have made them uncomfortable at the crease. The Aussies need a partnership badly and will hope the current pair will calm things down. New Zealand know that a couple of wickets more and they will inch closer to that elusive win against the hosts in Australia.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Cameron Green goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a run.
On a length and on middle, Cameron Green defends it out.
Full again and on the pads, Alex Carey misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to the left of the bowler. A single taken as Ferguson fields it himself.
Fuller one and on off, Cameron Green drives it past the diving cover fielder for a run.
This is short of a length and on middle, skids through the surface, Cameron Green looks to work it to the leg side but misses and gets hit high on his body due to the pace.
Lockie Ferguson starts off with a short-length delivery, on middle, Cameron Green gets behind and blocks it out.
As expected, Lockie Ferguson replaces Matt Henry from this end.
Quicker one, short and on off, Alex Carey goes back and taps it towards covers.

FOUR! Off the edge and this boundary has come against the run of play. Short in length and outside off, Carey rocks back to cut but the ball takes the outside edge and runs past short third man for a boundary.

Carey is safe! A floated delivery, full and outside off, Carey leans forward and pushes it gently towards cover-point. He looks for a run but is sent back. Carey dives back in and is found safe in the replays. The third umpire flashes 'not out' on the big screen.
A run out appeal! That seems close but the replay shows Alex Carey is in. Not out it is!
Flatter and around off, Alex Carey makes room to cut it, but bunts it onto the ground towards point.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off, Alex Carey leans on and blocks it out.
Gets some turn straightaway! This is short and on middle, turning in, Cameron Green tucks it through square leg for a run.
Change. Michael Bracewell is into the attack. Still no Lockie Ferguson at the moment. Maybe, he will be given Matt Henry's end.
On a length and on off, Alex Carey stays there and pushes it towards covers.
Angles a length ball onto the pads, Green helps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller and on off, Cameron Green drives it through cover-point for a brace.
Right on the money from Henry! This is on a good length and on middle, Cameron Green defends it to the off side.
Short of a length and on off, Alex Carey guides it past point for a run.
This is full and on off, Cameron Green opens the face of his bat and plays it towards third man for one.
Looped up and on off, Cameron Green stays back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Short again and on leg, Cameron Green knocks it towards mid on.
Tossed up, short and on middle, angling in, Cameron Green goes back and blocks it close from the stumps.
A bit short, on middle, turning in to the leg side, Alex Carey pulls it through square leg for a single.
Floated and around middle, Alex Carey blocks it back to Santner.
Gives it some air, on off, Alex Carey only manages to push it back to the bowler.
Cameron Green is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPS SHATTERED! Matt Henry roars in delight and Australia are now five down. Straightness is his signature, says the on-air commentator, and he reaps reward due to that quality. The speedster keeps his line on and around off and serves it on a shortish length at 137.2 kph. The ball lands and jags back in to breach Stoinis' back foot defense. It sneaks through and sends the bails flying. This has been yet another dismal display with the bat from the Kangaroos.
Another full delivery, on off, Marcus Stoinis knocks it towards covers.
Goes fuller and on off, Marcus Stoinis drives it firmly towards mid off for no run.
Short of a length and on middle, Alex Carey stays back and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
On a length and around off, Alex Carey guides it towards point.
Full and on off, Alex Carey blocks it out.
Quicker one, short and on off, Marcus Stoinis pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Alex Carey sweeps it aerially to deep square leg for one.

TURN AND BOUNCE! This is flighted around off, turning in sharply, Alex Carey tries to go for the reverse sweep but gets beaten due to the turn, and the ball goes off his pads over the keeper and towards fine leg. Two leg bye are taken.
Tossed up, full and on off, turning in, Alex Carey leans on and blocks it out.
Slower through the air, on middle, turning away a bit, Marcus Stoinis makes room and punches it towards sweeper cover for one.
Starts with a floated delivery, short and on off, Alex Carey works it off his back foot towards square leg for a single.

Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Mitchell Santner to bowl now. More than his striking rate, he is known for his economy, so clearly New Zealand are looking to tie one end up and attack with their seamers from the other end.
Length ball, outside off. Stoinis guides it through point and collects a brace. Powerplay 1 is done and it was soundly dominated by the Black Caps.
Extra pace and bounce here! On a length and just outside off, holding its line, Stoinis is beaten as he looks to defend by going on his toes.
Length ball, around off. Marcus hits it to point.
Tight from Henry! On middle. Blocked out.
Matt angles a full ball, across the left-hander. Carey slices his drive to third man for a run.
Right on the money from Henry! Length and around off. Stoinis defends it to point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Carey works it to mid off.
Boult drags his length back and serves it around middle. Kept out.
FOUR! Releases some pressure! Too full and Carey makes the most of it. He drives it past mid on for four.
Full, outside off, swinging away, it's driven to mid off.
Superb delivery yet again! Fuller ball, around off, swinging as well. Carey negotiates it well.
On middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, it is flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
On a length and outside off. Carey lets it go.
Henry serves it outside off. Carey shoulders arms.
Outside off, left alone.

Alex Carey walks out to bat now. Australia are in huge trouble now and they desperately need someone to hold their innings. It is now upto Alex Carey and Marcus Stoinis to stabilise their innings or else this could get worse for them.

OUT! TAKEN! David Warner places it straight into the hands of Michael Bracewell! Australia are in a mood to recreate what they did in the last match against Zimbabwe! Coming to the delivery - short of a length and on middle. Warner pulls it flat and hard. It comes off the middle but flies straight to Michael Bracewell at deep square leg. The only batter who looked in control during his stay at the crease goes now and Australia are four down.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, hit to mid off.
Marcus Stoinis is the next man in for Australia with his side in a spot of bother.

OUT! LBW! Trent Boult gets another one! He is spitting fire right now! Just brilliant from the Kiwi! Boult with his orthodox delivery! An inswinging length ball, around off. Marnus Labuschagne gets on the back foot as he looks to defend but misses and gets rapped first on the front pad and then on the second. A huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Marnus has a resigned look on his face, Warner tries to have a word with him but Labuschagne is certain that he's plumb in front. He walks back without taking the DRS and the Ball Tracking confirms that it's a good decision from Marnus. Three reds. Not a return to the ODI team he was hoping for.
Around off, it is flicked wide of mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, kept out safely from the back foot.
On a length and outside off at 134 clicks. Warner knocks it to point.
Length and outside off, dropped to point.
Boult gets it to swing away! This is outside off, it is pushed to mid off.
Full and on off, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
An appeal for LBW but the height was against Henry here! Henry serves it around off on a length. Labuschagne looks to defend but misses and gets hit high on the back leg.
A late inswinger! On a length and outside off. Labuschagne covers his off pole and leaves it alone.
A bit of width here, outside off. David cuts and the man at point dives to his left to make a half-stop. One run.
SIX! Counter-punch from Warner! This is full and on the pads. Warner whips it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On a length and on middle. Defended out.
Almost had another one! This is full and around off, jagging back in. Marnus Labuschagne does enough to defend this out. A wicket-maiden from Trent Boult!
Around off, blocked out.
Touch short and around off. Marnus Labuschagne pushes it to mid off.
Marnus Labuschagne comes out to the middle now.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Trent Boult is best in the business with the new ball and he has two wickets now. Smith's struggle comes to an end! Boult serves a length ball, outside off, the ball lands and moves back in a bit late. Smith tries to drive away from the body but manages an inside edge and the stumps are disturbed. Australia are rocked early by the Kiwi pacer. That's one shot that Smudge will look back in regret. Very loose.
BEATEN! Smith is struggling here! Length ball, slanting across, outside off. Smith looks to drive but misses.
On a length and angling outside off before nipping back in. Smith looks to defend but is beaten and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but the impact looked outside off.
Short of a length and on middle. Warner gets on his toes to defend.
FOUR! Good shot! Overpitched, outside off. Warner gets low and smashes it straight past mid off for a boundary.
Smith is off the mark! On a length and outside off, it skids through. Smith tries to drive it straight but gets a thick outside edge to third man for one.
Length ball, outside off at 138.2 kph. Smith is squared up a bit as he defends this one.
On a length and around off. Kept out.

Three runs! Short in length and outside off. Warner slices his drive over point. Trent Boult from third man runs across and puts in a dive to save a single. A good piece of fielding from Boult after some quality bowling.
On a length and around off, tight from Boult and Smith blocks it again.
Fuller and on middle. Smith makes a solid block.
Steven Smith walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! LBW! A string of low scores continues for Aaron Finch as he departs early again. Trent Boult gets the better of Aaron Finch yet again who keeps on struggling against the left-arm pacers. This is on a length and around middle and off, shaping back in. Finch, who is standing well ahead of the crease to negate the movement, leans a bit as he looks to play in front of his pads and onto the leg side but misses and gets hit on the front pad. A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire is quick to raise his dreaded finger. Aaron Finch reviews it! Hot Spot doesn't show anything while the Snicko shows no bat. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and Finch has to make his way back.
Too full and on middle, a hint of swing. Finch blocks it out.
TAP AND RUN! Touch fuller and on middle. Warner works it to mid on for a quick single.

FIVE RUNS! OVERTHROWS! On a length and around off. Finch taps it in front of cover and scampers across for a quick single. Santner picks and throws it at the bowler's end but misses. Finch puts in a big dive to get in. There is no one backing up and the ball rolls past mid-wicket and races into the fence.
On a good length, outside off. Warner punches it to covers.
Henry serves it a touch fuller and outside off, it is knocked to point.
FOUR! Wonderful timing from Warner to get off the mark! Length ball, outside off and skidding off the surface. Warner opens the face of the bat and guides it through point for a boundary.
Around off on a length. It is tapped to covers.
This one is on a length and outside off, nips a bit away. Warner tries to defend in front of his body but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Leg bye! Henry starts on the shorter side, angling on the hips. Finch hops but fails to tuck it away. It rolls off the thigh pad to square leg. Australia are underway!
Matt Henry to bowl from the other end.
A maiden to start proceedings! Boult makes it to swing away, this is on a length and just outside off. Warner blocks it on the deck.
On a length and around off. Warner stays back and defends it out.
Boult keeps the same line as he serves it on a length and outside off. Warner shoulders arms to it.
Another delivery which is outside off and moves further away from the left-hander. Left alone.
Boult steams in and serves it on a length and outside off, seaming away. Warner lets it go.
On a length and way outside off. Warner shoulders arms to it.
